prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Charlotte. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Good — I can give you specific salons to call, but to give exact addresses/phone numbers I’ll need your Charlotte neighborhood or ZIP. Without that, here are the best places to call (types and chains you’ll commonly find in Charlotte) and exactly why each is worth calling plus the questions to ask so you can pick the safest, best option.

Who to call (and why)
1. Palm Beach Tan (regional/national chain)
   - Why: Consistent standards, multiple Charlotte locations, a wide selection of bed strengths and spray booths, membership and package deals. Good if you want options and predictable service.

2. Sola Salons (booth-rental salons)
   - Why: Private rooms you can rent by the minute for UV or spray tanning; good if you want privacy or flexible scheduling. Ask whether technicians are onsite for spray tans.

3. SunTan City (chain)
   - Why: Often offers high-pressure beds and promotional pricing; good to call if you want stronger/shorter sessions and value options.

4. Local spray-tan boutique (search “spray tan Charlotte” and call the top-rated 2–3)
   - Why: Healthier sunless tanning; boutique shops often use higher-quality solutions (Versa, Mystic, Norvell) and trained techs or airbrush artists for natural results — best if you’re new to tanning or want an event tan.

5. Medspa or dermatology office offering professional sunless tanning
   - Why: Highly trained staff, custom color matching, medical-grade products — good if you have sensitive skin, pigmentation concerns, or want long-lasting, natural results.

6. Day spa with airbrush expertise / mobile airbrush techs
   - Why: Great for event or bridal tanning; individualized application and color matching.

What to ask when you call (exact questions to use)
- Do you offer UV tanning beds, spray tans (automated and/or airbrush), or both?
- What brands/types of beds do you have? (high-pressure vs low-pressure; how many minutes)
- How often are the bulbs replaced/when was last maintenance?
- Do you provide a skin-type consultation before first session?
- What brand of spray solution do you use? (brands like Versa, Mystic, Norvell are common)
- Are your spray techs certified? Do you offer patch tests?
- Do you require appointments or accept walk-ins?
- Do you offer first-time specials, packages, or memberships?
- What hygiene practices do you follow (cleaning between clients, towels, ventilation)?
- For spray tans: how long does the solution take to develop; any pre/post care instructions?

Safety and choice guidance (short)
- If you’re new to tanning, consider a professional spray tan first — no UV risk and immediate results.
- UV tanning carries skin-cancer and premature-aging risks. If you choose UV beds, start with a low-pressure bed and get a consultation about session length for your skin type.
- Bring/wear eye protection and use tanning-specific lotions as advised by the salon.

Want exact salons nearby?
Tell me your Charlotte neighborhood or ZIP and I’ll list 4–6 specific salons (names, addresses, phone numbers, and a short note on each) so you can call the ones that match your priorities (fast/high-pressure UV, private booths, spray-tan specialists, or best-reviewed).
